title: Desired Fertility, Realized Fertility and the Effects of China’s Universal Two-Child Policy
Addressing Population Ageing in China: Public Policy and Institutional Innovations
venue: Cambridge University Press Elements Series in Chinese Economy and Governance
abstract: China is entering a new demographic era marked by sustained population decline and rapid population ageing. Drawing on Chinese government statistics, international datasets, and recent academic evidence, this Element documents the speed and uneven geography of China’s transition, diagnoses its economic and social consequences, and proposes a portfolio of policy and institutional innovations. After an introductory section, Section 2 establishes the facts and drivers: fertility has fallen to among the world’s lowest levels while life expectancy has risen sharply, pushing the share of older adults upward and compressing the working-age population, with especially fast ageing in many rural and interior regions. Section 3 traces the downstream impact of this phenomenon on the social insurance systems and the real economy. It highlights mounting pressure on pay-as-you-go pensions, rising health and long-term care needs amid weakening family-based support, and emerging risks for labor supply, productivity, savings, and social cohesion—particularly as caregiving burdens fall disproportionately on women. Section 4 develops China-focused but internationally relevant innovations to “grow old without growing poor:” expanding safe home-equity release (including redesigned reverse mortgages), extending productive working lives through retirement-age reform paired with job redesign and reskilling, scaling long-term care insurance and service capacity, and strengthening community-based solutions such as time banking and senior co-housing. The Element also reviews evidence on pro-family policies, emphasizing childcare provision and work–family compatibility instead of one-off cash incentives. China’s vast size and heterogeneity create exceptional scope for experimentation and policy learning, offering lessons for other countries confronting similar ageing challenges. This Element complements existing policy options laid out by the Chinese government and other organizations such as the World Bank.

title: High-Speed Rail and China’s Electric Vehicle Adoption Miracle
abstract: Using China's expansion of the high-speed rail system (HSR) as a quasi-natural experiment, we analyze the comprehensive vehicle registration data from 2010 to 2023 to estimate the causal impact of HSR connectivity on the adoption of electric vehicles (EVs). Implementing several identification strategies, including staggered difference-in-differences (DID), Callaway and Sant'Anna (CS) DID, and two instrumental-variable approaches, we consistently find that, by alleviating range anxiety, the expansion of HSR can account for up to one third of the increase in EV market share and EV sales in China during our sample period, with effects particularly pronounced in cities served by faster HSR lines. The results remain robust when controlling for local industrial policies, charging infrastructure growth, supply-side factors, and economic development. We also find that HSR connectivity amplifies the effectiveness of charging infrastructure and consumer purchase subsidies in promoting EV adoption. Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
abstract_zh: 本文以中国高速铁路（HSR）系统的扩张作为准自然实验，利用2010至2023年全面的车辆登记数据，估计高铁互联对电动汽车（EV）普及的因果影响。我们采用了多种识别策略，包括交错双重差分（DID）、Callaway和Sant'Anna（CS）双重差分，以及两种工具变量方法，结果一致表明：通过缓解里程焦虑，高铁扩张可以解释样本期内中国电动汽车市场份额和销量增长的多达三分之一，且在高铁线路更快的城市中，这一效应尤为明显。在控制地方产业政策、充电基础设施增长、供给侧因素和经济发展之后，结果依然稳健。我们还发现，高铁互联增强了充电基础设施和消费者购车补贴在推动电动汽车普及方面的效果。美国国家经济研究局（NBER）工作论文系列的机构订阅者，以及发展中国家的居民，可在www.nber.org上免费下载本文，无需额外付费。

To Go Electric or To Burn Coal? A Randomized Field Experiment of Informational Nudges
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: Coal heating in residential homes is an important source of indoor air pollution, leading to detrimental health effects. We conduct a randomized field experiment in northern China using three types of SMS campaigns targeting three potential biases that may hinder the adoption of electric heating: a Cost SMS campaign, designed to address the overestimation of electricity expenses; a Health SMS campaign, aimed at addressing the underestimation of health damage associated with coal heating; and a Social Comparison SMS campaign, intended to inform households about the popularity of electric heating. We find that the Cost SMS backfires: it instead leads to a substantial reduction in electric heating, which can be attributed to salience bias induced by the Cost SMS, which drew heightened attention to the cost of electricity. The Health SMS is ineffective for households that underestimate the health damage of coal heating and even backfires for those who expressed little concern about the health consequences. Social Comparison SMS is only effective for a small proportion of households who were concerned about their neighbors' heating choices. Overall, our findings suggest that SMS campaigns targeting these biases are largely ineffective, and caution should be exercised when applying plausible nudge interventions. The findings also suggest that households may be motivated to maintain their beliefs and resist paternalistic interventions.
abstract_zh: 居民住宅中的燃煤取暖是室内空气污染的重要来源，并对健康造成不利影响。我们在中国北方开展了一项随机化现场实验，采用三类短信宣传活动，分别针对可能阻碍电采暖推广的三种潜在偏差：成本短信活动旨在纠正对电费的高估；健康短信活动旨在纠正对燃煤取暖健康损害的低估；社会比较短信活动则旨在告知家庭电采暖的普及程度。我们发现，成本短信活动适得其反：它反而导致电采暖使用显著减少，这可归因于成本短信引发的显著性偏差，即它使人们更加关注电费成本。健康短信对那些低估燃煤取暖健康损害的家庭无效，甚至对那些对健康后果几乎不关心的家庭产生了反效果。社会比较短信仅对一小部分关心邻居取暖选择的家庭有效。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，针对上述偏差的短信宣传活动基本无效，因此在运用看似合理的助推（nudge）干预时应当谨慎。研究结果还表明，家庭可能有动机维持其既有信念，并抵制家长式干预。

title: Window Dressing in the Public Sector: Evidence from China’s Compulsory Education Promotion Program
Environmentally-Inclined Politicians and Local Environmental Performance: Evidence from Publicly Listed Firms in China
abstract: We study how environmentally-inclined politicians (EIPs), i.e., politicians with prior environment-related working experience, affect local environmental performance in China. Firms located in cities with EIPs have lower levels of sulfur dioxide (SO2) emissions. The effect is attenuated when the politician is in his/her second term and among firms that are economically important. Firms in cities with EIPs commit less environmental violations, receive more green subsidies from the local government, and choose to establish new polluting subsidiaries in cities without EIPs.Furthermore, these EIPs do not have inferior economic performance and their promotion likelihood is negatively related to local emission levels. The findings overall suggest that local officials strategically leverage their expertise in environment protection to allocate more effort on environmental causes.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了具有环境相关工作经历的政治家（即“环境倾向型政治家”，EIPs）如何影响中国地方的环境绩效。位于有EIPs城市的企业，其二氧化硫（SO2）排放水平较低。当该政治家处于第二任期时，以及对于经济上重要的企业而言，这一效应有所减弱。位于有EIPs城市的企业环境违规行为较少，从地方政府获得的绿色补贴较多，并且会选择在没有EIPs的城市设立新的污染型子公司。此外，这些EIPs的经济绩效并不逊色，其晋升可能性与当地排放水平呈负相关。总体而言，研究结果表明，地方官员会策略性地利用其在环境保护方面的专业知识，从而在环境事务上投入更多精力。

title: An Alternative Test of Racial Prejudice in Motor Vehicle Searches: Theory and Evidence
abstract: We propose a simple model of trooper behavior to design empirical tests for whether troopers of different races are monolithic in their search behavior, and whether they exhibit relative racial prejudice in motor vehicle searches. Our test of relative racial prejudice provides a partial solution to the well-known inframarginality and omitted-variables problems associated with outcome tests. When applied to a unique dataset from Florida, our tests soundly reject the hypothesis that troopers of different races are monolithic in their search behavior, but the tests fail to reject the hypothesis that troopers of different races do not exhibit relative racial prejudice.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个简单的巡警行为模型，用以设计实证检验，考察不同种族的巡警在搜查行为上是否具有一致性，以及他们在机动车搜查中是否表现出相对的种族偏见。我们对相对种族偏见的检验，部分解决了结果检验（outcome test）中众所周知的非边际性（inframarginality）和遗漏变量问题。将该检验应用于一份来自佛罗里达州的独特数据集后，我们有力地拒绝了不同种族的巡警在搜查行为上具有一致性的假设，但未能拒绝不同种族的巡警并不表现出相对种族偏见的假设。
